```yaml
name: Codex Review & Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
      - epic

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  analyze-and-notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Analyze PR and Notify Code Owners
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          python - << 'EOF'
          import os
          import json
          import requests
          import re

          # Configuration
          GITHUB_TOKEN = os.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")
          PR_NUMBER = os.getenv("PR_NUMBER")
          REPO = os.getenv("REPO")
          OWNER, REPO_NAME = REPO.split("/")
          API_URL = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{OWNER}/{REPO_NAME}"
          HEADERS = {
              "Authorization": f"token {GITHUB_TOKEN}",
              "Accept": "application/vnd.github.v3+json"
          }

          # 1. Fetch PR Details
          pr_response = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/pulls/{PR_NUMBER}", headers=HEADERS)
          if pr_response.status_code != 200:
              print(f"Failed to fetch PR: {pr_response.status_code}")
              exit(1)
          
          pr_data = pr_response.json()
          pr_title = pr_data.get("title", "")
          pr_body = pr_data.get("body", "")
          base_branch = pr_data.get("base", {}).get("ref", "")
          
          # 2. Fetch Changed Files
          files_response = requests.get(f"{API_URL}/pulls/{PR_NUMBER}/files", headers=HEADERS)
          if files_response.status_code != 200:
              print(f"Failed to fetch files: {files_response.status_code}")
              exit(1)
          
          changed_files = files_response.json()
          file_paths = [f['filename'] for f in changed_files]

          # 3. Determine Code Owners
          # Simple heuristic: Check for specific paths mentioned in the request context
          # In a real scenario, you might parse CODEOWNERS file or use a more complex logic
          code_owners = []
          
          # Heuristic based on the provided context:
          # - Drawer/Navbar/UI changes -> UI Team
          # - Donor/Next Config -> Frontend/Platform Team
          
          ui_files = [f for f in file_paths if 'packages/ui' in f or 'components' in f]
          donor_files = [f for f in file_paths if 'apps/donor' in f]
          next_config_files = [f for f in file_paths if 'next.config' in f]
          
          if ui_files:
              code_owners.append("@ui-team")
          if donor_files or next_config_files:
              code_owners.append("@frontend-platform")
              
          # Fallback if no specific owners found but files changed
          if not code_owners and file_paths:
              code_owners.append("@core-team")

          # 4. Check for "Risky" patterns mentioned in the request
          risky_patterns = [
              "resolveDrawerSwipeDirection",
              "images.qualities",
              "@asym/config/site-client",
              "@asym/config/site"
          ]
          
          risky_files_found = []
          for file in changed_files:
              filename = file['filename']
              # We can't easily read file content without checking out, 
              # but we can check filenames for known risky areas
              if any(pattern in filename for pattern in ['drawer', 'navbar', 'next.config']):
                  risky_files_found.append(filename)

          # 5. Construct Comment
          comment_body = "## 🤖 Codex Review Summary\n\n"
          
          if risky_files_found:
              comment_body += "### ⚠️ High-Risk Areas Detected\n"
              comment_body += "The following files were modified and require careful review due to high blast radius:\n"
              for f in risky_files_found:
                  comment_body += f"- `{f}`\n"
              comment_body += "\n"
          
          if code_owners:
              comment_body += "### 👥 Code Owners\n"
              comment_body += "Please review the changes:\n"
              comment_body += " ".join(code_owners) + "\n\n"
          
          # Add Checklist Reminder if targeting epic/develop
          if base_branch in ['epic', 'develop']:
              comment_body += "### 📋 Deploy Checklist Reminder\n"
              comment_body += "- [ ] CI passes\n"
              comment_body += "- [ ] Migrations reviewed (or N/A)\n"
              comment_body += "- [ ] Migrations tested on staging (or N/A)\n"
              comment_body += "- [ ] New env vars added to all 3 Vercel projects (or N/A)\n"
              comment_body += "- [ ] Rollback plan reviewed\n"
              comment_body += "- [ ] Post-deploy smoke tests planned\n"

          # 6. Post Comment
          if comment_body:
              comment_response = requests.post(
                  f"{API_URL}/issues/{PR_NUMBER}/comments",
                  headers=HEADERS,
                  json={"body": comment_body}
              )
              if comment_response.status_code == 201:
                  print("Comment posted successfully.")
              else:
                  print(f"Failed to post comment: {comment_response.status_code}")
          else:
              print("No significant changes or owners detected to comment on.")

          EOF
```
